source_authorities: Vadhu Vara Ghatitartha Chandrika (వధూవర ఘటితార్థ చంద్రిక) by Bhaskara Bhujanga Rao

dina_koota.calculation: Count from Bride Nakshatra to Groom Nakshatra, divide by 9. Remainder gives Tara.

meaning.2: Sampat Tara — Wealth, happiness & great prosperity
meaning.4: Kshema Tara — Safety, comfort, auspicious life
meaning.6: Sadhana Tara — Accomplishment of all goals & success
meaning.7: Naidhana / Vadha Tara — Affliction, danger (Strictly Avoid)
meaning.8: Mitra Tara — Friendship, affection and mutual delight
meaning.9: Parama Mitra Tara — Supreme friendship and long-lasting love

gana_koota.compatibility: Deva-Deva: 6 pts (Best). Manushya-Manushya: 6 pts (Best). Deva-Manushya: 5 pts (Good). Rakshasa-Rakshasa: 6 pts (Good). Deva-Rakshasa or Manushya-Rakshasa: 0 pts (Incompatible, unless neutralized by Rashi Maitri or Stree Deergha).

mahendra_koota.rule: Distance of Boy nakshatra from Girl nakshatra is 4, 7, 10, 13, 16, 19, 22, or 25.
mahendra_koota.benefit: Promotes child-bearing, lineage continuation, and deep attachment.

stree_deergha.rule: Distance from Girl nakshatra to Boy nakshatra should exceed 13 (or minimum 9).
stree_deergha.benefit: Ensures long marital lifespan for the wife and perpetual auspiciousness.

yoni_koota.meaning: Biological compatibility, temperament, and marital bliss.

rashi_koota.shadashtaka_6_8: Generally avoided as Mrityu Shadashtaka, EXCEPT when Rashi lords are identical or mutual friends (Preeti Shadashtaka): Mesha-Vrishchika (both Mars) and Makara-Kumbha (both Saturn) are fully permitted!

graha_maitri.meaning: Intellectual rapport and mutual friendship between Rashi lords (Surya, Chandra, Kuja, Budha, Guru, Shukra, Shani).

vashya_koota.meaning: Mutual respect, devotion, and harmony between husband and wife.

rajju_koota.verdict: Same Rajju is to be avoided (especially Siro and Kantha). Exceptions from Vadhu Vara Ghatitartha Chandrika: When Pada is different, or Rashi Maitri is strong, dosha is mitigated.

vedha_koota.rule: Couples born in mutual Vedha nakshatras should not be matched without strong mitigating yogas.

nadi_koota.rule: Same Nadi (Nadi Dosha) carries 0 points. Exceptions: When Rashi is different although Nakshatra is same, or when Nakshatras differ within the same Rashi, Nadi Dosha is eliminated.

classical_exemptions: 1. Kuja in Mesha or Vrishchika (Own houses): Completely free of Kuja Dosha.
2. Kuja in Makara (Exaltation house): Completely free of Kuja Dosha.
3. Kuja in 2nd house in Mithuna or Kanya (Mercury houses): No dosha.
4. Kuja in 4th house in Mesha or Vrishchika: No dosha.
5. Kuja in 7th house in Karkataka (Neecha) or Makara (Uccha): No dosha.
6. Kuja in 8th house in Dhanus or Meena (Guru houses): No dosha.
7. Kuja in 12th house in Vrishabha or Tula (Shukra houses): No dosha.
8. Conjunction or aspect of Guru or Chandra with Kuja: Forms Mangala-Guru or Chandra-Mangala yoga, neutralizing the affliction.
9. Mutual Kuja Dosha (Doshakhyam): If BOTH boy and girl have Kuja dosha in their charts, the doshas neutralize each other and marriage is fully permitted.

essential_shuddhis: Saptama Shuddhi: 7th house from Vivaha Lagna must be vacant and free of any aspect from malefics.
Ashtama Shuddhi: 8th house from Vivaha Lagna must be strictly vacant (Mangalya Bala).
Karthari Dosha: 2nd and 12th houses from Vivaha Lagna must not both be occupied by natural malefics (Surya, Kuja, Shani, Rahu, Ketu).
Rikta Tithi Exclusions: Chavithi (4), Navami (9), and Chaturdashi (14) are strictly avoided.
Sthira Lagnas are mandatory for Apurva Gruhapravesham (Vrishabha, Simha, Vrishchika, Kumbha). Vrishabha and Simha are supreme.
Ashtama Shuddhi: 8th house from Lagna must be clean.
No Guru or Shukra Maudhyam (Combustion) during Apurva Gruhapravesham.
Sun must not be debilitated (Tula) or in Shunya Masas (Dhanus, Meena).
Uttarayana and Shukla Paksha are most auspicious.
Guru Bala: Guru in 2nd, 5th, 7th, 9th, or 11th from Janma Rashi is highly auspicious.
Lagna Shuddhi: Kendras and Trikonas occupied by Shubha Grahas (Guru, Shukra, Budha).
